<thought>From the spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199 (100 % intensity). The next prominent peak is at m/z ≈ 201 (≈ 98 % intensity), i.e., an M+2 peak with essentially equal intensity to the monoisotopic peak. This 1:1 M : M+2 pattern is characteristic of bromine (79Br/81Br ≈ 50 %/50 %). No other element shows such a definitive isotopic signature in the data. Therefore, bromine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
